title: Product discovery and audience
summary: Product discovery and audience operational rules curated for Zanker. Independent synthesis; consult primary sources for exact normative requirements.

rules.title: Audience backed by evidence
rules.intent: Distinguish observed user needs from assumptions and label uncertainty
principles: Distinguish observed user needs from assumptions and label uncertainty
acceptance: Every persona statement is linked to evidence or marked hypothesis

rules.title: Primary job to be done
rules.intent: Write the main user task as outcome, not a requested UI feature
principles: Write the main user task as outcome, not a requested UI feature
antiPatterns: Optimizing for requested screens without confirming user goal
acceptance: Success is measurable by task completion

rules.title: Stage-aware design
rules.intent: Adapt UX tradeoffs to product stage and existing users
principles: Adapt UX tradeoffs to product stage and existing users
antiPatterns: Redesigning established workflows without migration plan
acceptance: Migration and existing behavior constraints are recorded

rules.title: Context of use
rules.intent: Identify device, connectivity, urgency and repeat frequency before density decisions
principles: Identify device, connectivity, urgency and repeat frequency before density decisions
antiPatterns: One layout philosophy for all audiences

rules.title: High-consequence decisions
rules.intent: Provide confirmation, auditability and recoverability for irreversible actions
principles: Provide confirmation, auditability and recoverability for irreversible actions
acceptance: High-impact actions have explicit feedback and recovery

rules.title: Product success alignment
rules.intent: Connect interface outcomes to user benefit and business metric
principles: Connect interface outcomes to user benefit and business metric
acceptance: Proposed design has user and business success criteria
